description: This file implements an in-memory repository class 'NotesRepository' for managing Note entities. It provides CRUD operations such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing thread-safe mechanisms with RLock to ensure safety in a concurrent environment. The class interacts with 'Note' models defined elsewhere in the project.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository providing thread-safe CRUD operations for Note entities, managing an in-memory collection of notes with unique IDs.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with an empty notes dictionary, a starting ID of 1, and a re-entrant lock for thread safety.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes sorted by their ID in ascending order.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Note create_note(self, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID, given a title and content, then stores and returns it.

methods.name: Optional[Note] update_note(self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and/or content if it exists, sets 'updated_at' to current UTC time, and returns the updated note or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returning True if successful, False if the note does not exist.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_note(self, title: str, content: str) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_note(self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = No/
ctags.signature: (self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
